name: cache-meter
description: A quiet meter above the prompt: prompt cache warm or cold, time left, context size, what the next message costs warm and cold, cache hit rate, 5h and 7d usage. /cache opens the full breakdown.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key. Set it by hand if you changed promptCacheTtl.

guard.title: Cold send guard
guard.description: confirm: hold a message sent into a cold cache once and show the price, the resend goes through. warn: only show the price. off: nothing.
